feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
entry.summary: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

entry.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

entry.title: 'Lincoln in the Bardo' takes a distinctly American grief to the Met stage
entry.summary: With music by Missy Mazzoli, George Saunders' award-winning Civil War novel comes to surreal life in a stage adaptation making its world premiere at The Metropolitan Opera.

entry.title: Cardi B: Tiny Desk Concert
entry.summary: In leather pants and a power blazer, Cardi B brings a humble and humorous spirit to the Desk as she runs through a set packed with hits.

entry.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
entry.summary: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

entry.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
entry.summary: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

entry.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
entry.summary: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

entry.title: Alberta voters weigh future in Canada
entry.summary: On Monday voters in the oil-rich Canadian province of Alberta are deciding whether to take the first step toward a future referendum on independence.

entry.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
entry.summary: Trump said in a post on social media that Netanyahu "has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran."

entry.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
entry.summary: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.
